reasons.text: A 3.2 m dropped kerb to a 5.0 m by 2.6 m permeable hardstanding gives one off-street space for a 3-bedroom house.
The highway authority confirms Sandpiper Road is a 20 mph street with no through traffic, so the 2.4 m by 43 m visibility splay is waived for this access.
The applicant's agent asks for approval and accepts any necessary conditions.

conditions.text: Before the access is first used, a visibility splay of 2.4 m by 43 m shall be provided on both sides and kept free of obstruction over 0.6 m.
The hardstanding shall be laid in permeable paving and retained so.

citations.quote: We confirm the visibility splay under Policy T2 is not required for this access.
